prompts.closed:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: portrait 4:5 cartoon scene for the right half of a premium Mac utility App Store hero. 
Create one original stylized 3D cartoon illustration. A cheerful adult developer in a cobalt-blue chore jacket, light tee and charcoal trousers steps out through the doorway of a contemporary studio, carrying a single fully closed 14-inch notebook computer in one hand at hip height. Their other hand swings naturally with the step. Show the laptop prominently near the center of the composition, about one third of image width. Rotate it slightly toward camera so its recognizable graphite-aluminum lid, thin base, closed seam, back hinge and two small side ports are visible. The hand supports its bottom edge and leaves the front and seam clearly visible. This notebook is the visual focal point. Full head to lower legs, torso in a three-quarter view, coherent weight shift in mid-stride, ample headroom and side clearance. Original adult character with simple friendly shapes and expressive features. Rich blue jacket, warm ivory and light wood doorway, chalky warm gray flooring and a soft blue shadow on the wall, gentle afternoon light. Sophisticated tactile editorial cartoon style with matte, softly rounded shapes, subtle fabric and fine clay textures and clean graphic silhouettes. 
One person, one laptop. No text, logos, UI, open screen, bags, cups, confetti, glow, motion trails, watermark or overlays. Only the clean portrait illustration.
prompts.laptop_refinement:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the approved cartoon artwork to edit. Make a small, highly localized edit to the closed laptop in the character’s hand, preserving the portrait crop, character's identity, expression, hair, clothing, hands and grip, pose, doorway, shadows, lighting, colors and background. Match the slim, flat, rounded aluminum profile and two-piece shut lid/base of a 13-inch 2025 MacBook Air. Keep the same graphite finish and projected footprint, align lid and base with one thin even seam, and preserve the hand occlusion.
At this viewing angle the long, lower horizontal edge toward the viewer is the laptop's front opening edge, not the I/O side. Remove the two existing USB holes from that edge and replace them with uninterrupted, smoothly finished aluminum, with at most a subtle centered shallow thumb recess partially hidden by the hand. Leave the very narrow, foreshortened corner smooth. The USB-C and MagSafe ports are on the far short side of the notebook and outside of view. Do not draw any holes, vents, plugs, or extra markings onto the front edge. Keep the outside lid completely blank, with no Apple logo, other logo, text, or sticker. Edit only the laptop. Render the whole image in the same portrait aspect ratio and original matte 3D cartoon style.
prompts.open:
Use case: identity-preserve cartoon edit. Image 1 is the approved character and scene reference for a matched before-and-after layout.
Create a companion portrait with precisely the same original 3D cartoon developer, face, tousled hair and beard, cobalt jacket, cream tee, dark trousers, shoes, matte materials, wooden doorway, lighting and portrait camera framing. Show the inconvenience of walking while the same notebook is still open. The developer is still stepping out, taking a shorter tentative step and looking down slightly toward the computer. Both forearms extend forward at waist height, palms naturally supporting the bottom of the open graphite notebook on both sides. The computer stays solidly supported in both hands. The lid is open about 100 degrees with the hinge across the full rear edge and a thin base and keyboard plane. Show the opening angle clearly in three-quarter side profile, with enough view of both the lid and the base to read as an open laptop. The screen faces the developer, showing a dark, indistinct reflection if a sliver is visible. Use MacBook Air-inspired thin rounded aluminum proportions, a clean port-free front edge, and a blank unmarked outer lid. Keep head, shoulders and the full device in frame. 
One continuous portrait artwork, matching the reference’s 4:5 shape and visual fidelity. No logos, text, dialogue, UI overlay, comparison grid or duplicated person.
prompts.open_expression_edit:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the exact cartoon artwork to edit. Change only the man's facial expression. Give him a clear but understated unhappy, inconvenienced look while he walks holding the open laptop with both hands: the inner eyebrows pull together slightly, a small furrow appears between the brows, the gaze stays directed down at the laptop, the cheeks relax, and the mouth is closed with subtly downturned corners. Fully remove the broad toothy smile and all visible teeth. The discomfort should be legible at a thumbnail size and still feel human and restrained, like a developer mildly frustrated by having to carry the laptop open. 
Preserve his identity, hairstyle, beard, skin tone, head position, silhouette, pose, hands and finger placement, jacket, trousers, shoes, the port-free front and blank lid of the graphite laptop and its exact opening angle, the doorway, plants, lighting, shadows, camera framing and the original 4:5 portrait composition. No changes outside the face. Return the entire edited illustration.

composition: The Chinese and English variants share the same two illustrations. Headlines and labels are typeset separately. The App Store lead image includes a localized render of the native interface.
